findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Greek side labels instead of the established απέναντι πλευρά and παρακείμενη πλευρά terms.
evidence: The explanatory paragraph used the full side terms while the formulas displayed only απέναντι and παρακείμενη.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Greek side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Greek side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The inverse formulas omitted πλευρά although the section consistently described απέναντι πλευρά and παρακείμενη πλευρά.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established Greek side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Greek explanation.
evidence: The example labels omitted πλευρά while the explanatory paragraph used the full side terms.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to απέναντι πλευρά and παρακείμενη πλευρά.
